title: Verdacht der Beihilfe zum Computerbetrug – Durchsuchungsbeschlüsse und Haftbefehle vollstreckt

extraction.summaryEn: Berlin police, with Serbian authorities, executed search warrants and arrest warrants against suspects accused of aiding computer fraud via a spoofed-number VoIP service used in fake bank and police phone scams. Further searches took place in Berlin, Hesse and North Rhine-Westphalia, and the platform's infrastructure was seized.
